description: Add an Escape-key pause with a PAUSED overlay to the existing plumber.html game with the smallest clean in-place change.

criteria: plumber.html now has an Escape-key pause that freezes updates and shows a PAUSED overlay, with Escape again resuming. The change is surgical: the pre-existing movement, jump, coin, score, and game-over behavior are all intact and the file is still a single self-contained canvas game.
